body.text: How many days must you stay in Istanbul for cast removal and check-ups?

Most patients travelling for primary rhinoplasty in Istanbul need 7 to 10 nights on the ground. According to [NHS guidance on cosmetic surgery abroad](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) and [BAPRAS patient advice](https://www.bapras.org.uk/public/patient-information/cosmetic-surgery/cosmetic-surgery-abroad), travellers should wait 7 to 10 days after facial cosmetic procedures before flying home due to swelling, bleeding risk, and post-surgical blood clot considerations.

A realistic Istanbul stay begins with an in-person consultation and blood tests on Day 1 or 2, surgery and one overnight hospital stay on Day 2 or 3, and five to six quiet days at a nearby hotel. External splints and internal silicone stents are commonly removed around Day 6 or 7, followed by taping and a final check before departure. Booking a return flight for Day 5 leaves no buffer for delayed cast removal or minor post-operative bruising checks.
ENT specialist vs plastic surgeon — how do credentials differ in Türkiye?

In Türkiye, both Otorhinolaryngology (ENT / Kulak Burun Boğaz) specialists and Plastic, Reconstructive, and Aesthetic Surgery (Plastik, Rekonstrüktif ve Estetik Cerrahi) specialists are legally licensed to perform rhinoplasty after completing national medical school and multi-year surgical residency. ENT training centres on nasal airways, septal structure, and sinus anatomy, while plastic surgery training covers facial aesthetics and reconstructive techniques across the body.

Rather than relying on title alone, patients should verify a surgeon's official Turkish Ministry of Health specialist registration, hospital operating privileges, and membership in recognised societies such as [ISAPS](https://www.isaps.org/discover/patients-home/safety-considerations/) or national boards. Both the [BAAPS cosmetic tourism guide](https://baaps.org.uk/patients/safety_in_surgery/cosmetic_tourism.aspx) and [NHS advice](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) stress speaking directly with the operating surgeon—not only a sales coordinator—before committing.
What is the realistic 2026 cost range for primary vs revision rhinoplasty?

In 2026, realistic hospital-based pricing in Istanbul generally ranges from roughly EUR 3,000 to EUR 5,500 for primary rhinoplasty, while revision rhinoplasty typically starts around EUR 5,000 and can exceed EUR 9,000 depending on operative time and cartilage grafting. Quotes far below market norms frequently exclude hospital fees, anaesthetist charges, pre-operative blood panels, or overnight nursing care.

When reviewing quotes for rhinoplasty istanbul 2026, request an itemised written breakdown rather than a bundled "all-inclusive" headline figure. Under the [Turkish Ministry of Health Regulation on International Health Tourism](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-108974/regulation-on-international-health-tourism-and-tourist-health.html), authorised providers must follow clear patient-information standards. If you are considering a second or third nasal procedure, read our dedicated guide on [revision rhinoplasty in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/revision-rhinoplasty-turkey).

items: Confirm the clinic or hospital holds an active [Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html).
Verify the exact hospital name where surgery will occur—not just a consultation office address.
Ask in writing who administers general anaesthesia and whether an overnight hospital stay is included.
Confirm you will receive English-language operative notes, discharge summaries, and emergency contact details.
Check whether your travel insurance excludes complications from planned elective surgery abroad.

faq.q: Can I fly home 5 days after rhinoplasty in Istanbul?
faq.a: Flying on Day 5 is generally too early. Both NHS and BAPRAS guidance recommend waiting 7 to 10 days after facial cosmetic surgery, and most surgeons remove the external cast around Day 6 or 7.

faq.q: Does an ENT or a plastic surgeon give better cosmetic results?
faq.a: Neither specialty automatically guarantees a better outcome. Individual rhinoplasty experience, verifiable long-term case documentation, airway competence, and hospital standards matter far more than the residency label alone.

faq.q: Are hospital overnight stays standard for rhinoplasty in Istanbul?
faq.a: Most full-service hospitals keep rhinoplasty patients for one night under nursing observation after general anaesthesia before discharging them to a nearby recovery hotel the next morning.

faq.q: Why do revision rhinoplasty quotes cost significantly more than primary surgery?
faq.a: Revision cases involve internal scar tissue, longer general anaesthesia, and frequently require harvesting ear or rib cartilage to rebuild structural support, increasing both surgical and hospital theatre costs.

faq.q: What if I need urgent assistance while in Türkiye?
faq.a: In addition to your hospital's 24-hour medical contact, the Turkish Ministry of Health operates a multilingual [International Health Services Call Center](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-90754/international-health-services-call-center-commences-service.html) (+90 850 288 38 38) for international patients.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye choose my rhinoplasty surgeon for me?
faq.a: No. We are independent of provider commissions and never promote partner clinics or surgeons; you select your licensed medical team, and we coordinate your travel, hotel, and ground logistics around your clinical schedule.
